text:
**There is evidence of tree-cover loss in an area mapped as native forest, but it is not yet corroborated.**

In 2025, satellite data mapped approximately 13.5 hectares of tree-cover loss on the property, about 3.9% of its area. Of that loss area, 13.1 hectares overlapped native forest on Uruguay’s 2021 forest map.

The finding is pending corroboration because no later year has yet been observed. Tree-cover loss alone does not establish permanent deforestation, a change in land use, or the cause of the loss.
